_note: Descriptions for the Information Packages and the derived packages that subset them. The group is what the workbook's own heading row says and is authoritative. The gloss expands an abbreviation the workbook never spells out; where the source is 'editorial' it is our wording, not WCO's, and should be checked before publication.

bip-dec.title: Declaration
bip-dec.subtitle: Base Information Package
bip-dec.description: Business to government submissions: import and export customs declarations, cargo reports and transit declarations.

bip-lpco.title: LPCO
bip-lpco.subtitle: Base Information Package
bip-lpco.description: Licences, permits, certificates and other documents, such as a certificate of origin or a phytosanitary certificate.

aip.title: Additional
aip.subtitle: Additional Information Package
aip.description: A wrapper around business information held in a Base Information Package: Response for government to business, Intergov for government to government. Its relationship to a BIP is composition, not association.

mdip.title: Meta Data
mdip.subtitle: Meta Data Information Package
mdip.description: The technical aspect of a data exchange, separated so the other packages carry only business content.

mar-api.name: Maritime API
mar-api.gloss: Advance Passenger Information for maritime arrivals and departures, aligned to the IMO FAL forms.

mar-bri.name: Maritime BRI
mar-bri.gloss: Booking Reservation Information. Added in WCO Data Model 4.1.0 for the cruise industry.

upu-cusitm.name: UPU CUSITM
upu-cusitm.gloss: The Universal Postal Union message by which a postal operator sends mail item information to its local customs authority.

upu-refrsp.name: UPU REFRSP
upu-refrsp.gloss: One of the WCO-UPU joint message standards version 2, alongside CUSITM and CUSRSP. The workbook does not spell the abbreviation out.

coo-wco-tcro.name: Certificate of Origin
coo-wco-tcro.gloss: Certificate of Origin, under the WCO Technical Committee on Rules of Origin.

customs-bond.name: Customs Bond
customs-bond.gloss: A customs bond: the guarantee lodged against duties and taxes.

etir.name: eTIR
etir.gloss: The UNECE eTIR international system, which carries TIR transit data between customs administrations.

sstl.name: SSTL
sstl.gloss: Smart and Secure Trade Lanes, the customs to customs exchange piloted on selected trade lanes.

aeo-master-data.name: AEO Master Data
aeo-master-data.gloss: The master data describing an Authorised Economic Operator, exchanged between administrations.

aeomra.name: AEOMRA
aeomra.gloss: Authorised Economic Operator Mutual Recognition Arrangement: the exchange that lets one administration recognise another's AEOs. Marked work in progress in the workbook.

cntrl.name: CNTRL
cntrl.gloss: Control: a response telling the declarant that the goods or the declaration have been selected for control.

inf.name: INF
inf.gloss: Information: a response carrying information rather than a decision.

bussval.name: BUSSVAL
bussval.gloss: Business validation: a response reporting whether the submission passed the business rules.

techval.name: TECHVAL
techval.gloss: Technical validation: a response reporting whether the submission was well formed and schema valid.

sta.name: STA
sta.gloss: Status: a response reporting the current state of a declaration.

upu-cusres.name: UPU CUSRES
upu-cusres.gloss: The Universal Postal Union response to a CUSITM message. The workbook spells it CUSRES in the column and CUSRSP2 in the heading above it.
